entries.title: Crewmates leave out comments that only repeat the code
entries.body: At Default and Careful, crewmates write a code comment only when it explains something the code cannot show, such as why it is this way. They leave out comments that restate the code, excuse a shortcut instead of fixing it, or are no longer true, and every independent review flags such comments in the change it reads. A project's own rule on comments still wins, and turning off Rigor levels in Settings → Runbooks turns these rules off too.
entries.noPicture: This changes the guidance crewmates and reviewers follow, not a view or control.
